messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Creating a Package
parts: .onLoad is a hook that gets called when your package is loaded via library(packageName). Take a look at the manual for writing R extensions http://cran.r-project.org/doc/manuals/r-release/R-exts.html. There are also a number of package tutorials out there: e.g. http://www.stat.columbia.edu/~gelman/stuff_for_blog/AlanRPackageTutorial.pdf
